verdict.rationale: Extend's pricing page lists BYOC (your VPC) and Hybrid deployments. Running Extend in your own VPC lets you decide where data physically resides, but that is a deployment-model path rather than a documented region-selection feature. Missing for 10: explicit region or residency selection for the hosted service, a list of available regions, documentation of how BYOC or Hybrid controls data location, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
